home.title: Checking your catalog shouldn't be a tool you remember to add.
home.tagline: loclizr build turns your JSON translation catalogs into typed message functions, checks the catalogs on every build, and writes a context record for whoever translates next.
home.typedBody: Plain ESM with declarations, one function per message. A renamed placeholder breaks the call site at typecheck, not in production.
home.checksBody: Missing translations, ICU syntax errors and arguments that differ between locales fail the build.
home.recordBody: Argument types, plural shape and where each message is used, committed in the same pull request as the string change.
home.translated: This page is rendered by loclizr. Switch the language in the header and it changes without a reload.
